verdict.rationale: Supabase documents that its CLI 'runs the entire Supabase stack locally, on your machine or in a CI environment.' Supporting this are a version-pinned npm dev dependency, env-var telemetry opt-out, PAT-header auth for the MCP server in CI, and a Management API OpenAPI spec (probe-verified). CLI and API access to advisors and per-PR branching / auto-deploy on push round out a strong headless automation surface; community reports on local Docker-based setup are mixed (one easy, one 'couldn't get it to work') but do not concretely refute CI use. Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end CI workflow example (e.g., GitHub Actions setup and non-interactive auth flags), consistent independent hands-on corroboration of CI runs.
